observation: What buffalo density does v3 model near Ludhiana, India, in 1963? At 76.05°E, 30.90°N, band 1 (intensity) of LivestockMap/Buffa_1963.tif gave 40.4081 heads/km² at pixel 5452, line 1187 (zero-based). Anonymous range GET returned 206, exact bytes 582055744–585638275, validated member CRC32 1575933d. The provider specifies modelled heads/km².
gap: Band 1 has no declared NoData value in GDAL metadata. At 77.2167°E, 28.6167°N it returned NaN. Explicitly discard non-finite samples even when the reader reports no mask.

observation: What was banana yield in Bengo, Angola, for the April 2008 Main harvest? The first CSV row, fnid AO2008A101 (planting October 2007), reports 19,588 metric tonnes on 1,364 ha, yielding 14.360703812316716 t/ha; qc_flag=0 means no flag. Anonymous HTTP 200, 25,312,039 bytes. The SHA-256 f659e121e315b9d8656699e4b16421ed3b313e4c8d09d15199452000836dbef9 matches both the card and Dryad release 12 file 4864223, hvstat_africa_data_v1.2.csv.
gap: Dryad archive GET returns 401; the pinned mirror works. The linked README labels the table v1.1, although the headers align and Dryad also defines the units. The card and Dryad abstract describe 574,204 records; the v1.2 CSV has 217,487 data rows. Specify what the former count represents and for which release.

observation: Question: What land-cover class and sampling date does a northern Ghana point represent? The anonymous V1.1 manifest identifies 02b. northern_ghana_samples.gpkg (831,488 bytes) and 01b. class_name.tab. The public DDI confirms discrete fields class and name; collection was 2020–2024 and reported coverage 2018–2024. Both anonymous file requests returned HTTP 400 explicitly requiring Alliance Guestbook 306. Its enabled form marks name, email, institution, position and intended use optional. No form submitted.
gap: A point coordinate, date and class-to-label match require the guestbook-mediated files. The version landing page returned an empty HTTP 202 to the command-line client, so the interactive button was not independently tested.

observation: Question: How much nitrous oxide did drained cropland organic soils emit in one Dutch cell in 1992? An anonymous download of FAOSTAT.DROSE-A.1992.CROP.N2O.tif (41,722,737 bytes) yielded 0.000560893153306097 Gg N2O, about 0.561 metric tonnes, at the cell centre 4.7291667° E, 52.2208333° N (zero-based column 22167, row 4533). Rasterio and GDAL agreed; mask 255, NoData −9999. The provider’s release 1.0 collection identifies croplandn2o as N2O emissions from cropland organic soils in Gg; the 30-arc-second pixel is an annual model estimate.

What January precipitation normal does CHELSA V1.2 give at Bogotá, Colombia (74.08°W, 4.61°N)? The January prec GeoTIFF returned 32 mm in band 1 at pixel 12710, line 9526 (zero-based). This is the mean of January precipitation totals over 1979–2013. Raster NoData is −32767.

Question: what was reconstructed 2 m air temperature at 0°N, 0°E at 1979-01-01 00:00 UTC? The linked 2,386,828-byte first-hour bitstream was retrieved anonymously; SHA-256 matched cf6a9a4f44790d414a791ea7cb2bb50fa037cf1527ef35d4ed187073a29155e9. The documented binary header was parsed: 18 × 36 coded shape and two streams of 2,386,800 and 8 bytes. The configuration and decoder give t2m channel 263 and inverse normalization. A clean Python 3.10.20 macOS ARM64 source installation, with the checkout on PYTHONPATH and a module-object downloader patch, ran the official 268-channel checkpoint on CPU and decoded the entire hour. The de-normalized tensor shape was [268,721,1440]; [263,360,0] = 298.3111572265625 K. This is the lossy reconstruction.
gap: The as-written string patch raised AttributeError in Python 3.10 because cra5.api exports a class named cra5_api. Use from importlib import import_module and patch.object(import_module("cra5.api.cra5_api"), "era5_downloader") during constructor execution. Run from the pinned checkout or put the checkout on PYTHONPATH; the editable install alone did not expose cra5 when the script was outside it. The pinned dataset licence and later licence differ as the entry states.

observation: Question: what was annual mean land surface temperature at a valid Nauru pixel in 2023? GDAL read band 1 of the anonymous 6,094-byte 60 × 62 Float32 GeoTIFF. Zero-based column 36, row 25 has centre 166.939581945575°E, 0.523749661905°S (WGS 84). Its stored value is 311.731109619141 K. 2,578 of 3,720 cells were valid after excluding -99999. WorldPop’s Nauru record specifies kelvin and MODIS/Terra land surface temperature.
gap: None for the Nauru 2023 point query.

observation: How many synthetic 2015 residents of Albania region ALBr208 are coded rural in GLOPOP-S v4.5? The anonymous 1,633-byte gzip file matched its MD5. Decoding the 15 int32 columns gave 1,015 people with RURAL=1 (rural) and 424 with RURAL=0 (urban), totalling 1,439 people and 357 distinct household IDs, matching the provider’s regional counts.

What GDP per capita does the v3 admin-2 grid assign to the cell containing Bogotá, Colombia (74.08°W, 4.61°N), in 2022? Band 33, named gdp_pc_2022, returned 23,850 constant 2017 international dollars per person (PPP) at pixel 211, line 170 (zero-based). It is a 30-arc-minute administrative estimate. Whole-file MD5 matched.

How much daily precipitation does the model project near Bogotá on 1 January 2015? The NESM3 SSP5-8.5 r1i1p1f1 v1.1 precipitation Zarr returned 3.545511484146118 mm/day at 4.625°N, 74.125°W. The anonymous SAS allowed reads of the consolidated metadata, lat/lon/time coordinate chunks and part of pr/0.1.1. The decoded noleap time index 0 was day 4015 since 2004-01-01 12:00, or 2015-01-01 12:00. Array index [0,378,423].
gap: None for the tested question. Obtain a fresh anonymous token and append it to each blob URL.

observation: Could an anonymous analyst obtain an event-level impact observation from MERGE v1 and determine its location, date and impact magnitude? Zenodo record 16837695 identifies v1 and shows restricted files. Its embedded access settings set allow_guest_requests and allow_user_requests to false. The v2 DOI resolves to record 24127714, which lists an openly downloadable archive and says it removed all EM-DAT data except DisNo. No v1 observation was read.
gap: No anonymous file or access-request route for v1. Zenodo offers sign-in to check pre-existing access. The publicly documented v2 successor cannot verify v1 impact values.

observation: What land cover and field area were recorded at Koumbia on 10 October 2015? The transferred CIRAD V4 WFS layer TETIS:BD_JECAM_CIRAD_2023 returns feature BD_JECAM_CIRAD_2023.1, Id=8218, in Burkina Faso, with LandCover=Cropland, CropType1=Young fallow and Area_ha=0.936. One WGS84 polygon vertex is 3.829473 degrees W, 11.216709 degrees N. A count=1 query reports 31,879 features matched for the transferred layer. The paper describes 27,074 polygons for 2013–2020 and directs readers to a Dataverse DOI which displays V4 as deaccessioned and directs them to the 2013–2022 transfer.
gap: Only the 2013–2022 transfer was sampled. An observation dated 2015 in that layer does not verify that the same feature, coding or area was present in the 27,074-polygon paper release. No independently retrievable copy of the earlier data was identified on the provider path.

observation: What is the projected mean January precipitation near Bogotá for the 2030s? The linked BCC-CSM1-1-M, RCP2.6, r1i1p1, 10-arc-minute ZIP contained all 12 monthly ASCII grids. prec_1.asc gave 33 mm for a climatological January in 2020–2049 at 4.58333°N, 74.08333°W (zero-based row 512, column 635). The raster header gives 2160 × 900 cells, southwest corner (−180, −60), and nodata −9999. The WDCC record confirms the period and parent product; the article reports the precipitation units.
gap: None for the linked sample. The supplementary CCAFS landing page returned HTTP 403, but the direct ZIP and archival citation were accessible.

observation: What cocoa score does model 2026a give at 7.67°W, 6.71°N in 2024? The public layer page documents the 2024 selection and the unitless 0–1 model probability of cocoa presence at 10 m. The storage guide identifies the tile by its southwest corner (−8°, 6°) and describes the float32 probability band. Anonymous requests to the release index and inferred tile both returned HTTP 400 UserProjectMissing. The Earth Engine registration URL redirected to Google sign-in. No pixel value was read.
gap: A registered Earth Engine project or an authenticated Requester Pays billing project is needed for these routes. Tile existence and numeric probability remain unverified.
